previous_discrepancy_explanation: The prior report reported A0=194 (181 correct), A1=108 (94 correct), A2=22 (14 correct), A3=76 (69 correct), summing to 358 correct. This occurred because scratch/exp0071_state_logs.jsonl contained 239 total entries (with 33 redundant duplicate retries from transient executions). The prior analysis parsed raw log lines rather than assigning a mutually exclusive terminal action per unique case ID, double-counting actions and losing 6 correct predictions in the arithmetic.
